contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN MAGNEN[----] ; R/ FELICITAS [REI PVBLICAE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), Felicitas rei publicae issue of 350-351, Reece period 18. Obverse description; Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right, large head. Obverse inscription: DN MAGNEN[----]. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding Victory on globe and standard. Reverse inscription: FELICITAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 21.5mm, Weight: 2.94gms, die axis: 6
